title: DownloadPlan
description: Presigned GET plan for any backend.

get_url.description: Presigned GET URL or local server route URL.

ttl_secs.description:
URL time-to-live in seconds.

For presigned URL backends (S3, GCS, Azure) this is the URL expiry in seconds. For the local filesystem backend this field is `0` (the server route does not expire).
